47593-the-ladies-lindores-vol-3-of-3.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "Torrance!" repeated Beaufort, bewildered. The world seemed all to reel about him. He gazed at his companion with eyes wide opened but scarcely capable of vision. By-and-by he sat down abruptly on the nearest chair. He did not hear what Millefleurs was saying. Presently he turned to him, interrupting him unconsciously. "Torrance!" he repeated; "let there be no mistake.

63432-colony-of-the-unfit.title: Colony Of The Unfit
63432-colony-of-the-unfit.creator: Unknown
63432-colony-of-the-unfit.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. John drove past the old wooden houses of their small city and then let out speed on the highway before he answered, "The Leader says that is what we should do--harden our emotions for the sake of a better race. You and I are in the minority. Those years on the Moon trip have left us out of date."

arxiv-1907-01101.title: A Simulation Study of Social-Networking-Driven Smart Recommendations for IoV
arxiv-1907-01101.creator: Kashif Zia, Arshad Muhammad, Dinesh Kumar Saini
arxiv-1907-01101.description: Abstract Social aspects of connectivity and information dispersion are often ignored while weighing the potential of Internet of Things (IoT). In the specialized domain of Internet of Vehicles (IoV), Social IoV (SIoV) is introduced realization its importance. Assuming a more commonly acceptable standardization of Big Data generated by IoV, the social dimensions enabling its fruitful usage remains a challenge.

arxiv-2012-03967.creator: Jun Gao, Xiao-Wei Wang, Wen-Hao Zhou, Zhi-Qiang Jiao, Ruo-Jing Ren, Yu-Xuan Fu, Lu-Feng Qiao, Xiao-Yun Xu, Chao-Ni Zhang, Xiao-Ling Pang, Hang Li, Yao Wang, Xian-Min Jin

arxiv-2103-12669.title: Log canonical models of foliated surfaces Thanks: The author was partially supported by NSF research grants no: DMS-1801851, DMS-1840190 and by a grant from the Simons Foundation; Award Number: 256202.
arxiv-2103-12669.creator: Yen-An Chen
arxiv-2103-12669.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Yen-An Chen. We study log canonical models of foliated surfaces of general type. In particular, we show that log canonical models of general type and their minimal partial du Val resolutions are bounded. Moreover, we show the valuative criteria of separatedness and properness and a property related to local-closedness for the moduli functor ℳ P sm {\mathcal{M}}_{P}^{\textnormal{sm}} which parametrizes the stable smoothable foliated surfaces pairs. On the way, we also show a result on the invariance of plurigenera.

arxiv-2104-06645.title: Jointly Learning Truth-Conditional Denotations and Groundings using Parallel Attention
arxiv-2104-06645.creator: Leon Bergen, Dzmitry Bahdanau, Timothy J. O’Donnell
arxiv-2104-06645.description: Abstract We present a model that jointly learns the denotations of words together with their groundings using a truth-conditional semantics. Our model builds on the neurosymbolic approach of Mao et al. 2019 , learning to ground objects in the CLEVR dataset ( Johnson et al. 2017a ) using a novel parallel attention mechanism.

arxiv-2105-00325.title: A Game Theoretic Algorithm for Elite Customer Identification in Online Fashion E-Commerce
arxiv-2105-00325.creator: Chandramouli K, Gopinath A, Girish Satyanarayana, Ravindra babu Tallamraju
arxiv-2105-00325.description: Abstract Myntra is an online fashion e-commerce company based in India. At Myntra, a market leader in fashion e-commerce in India, customer experience is paramount and a significant portion of our resources are dedicated to it. Here we describe an algorithm that identifies eligible customers to enable preferential product return processing for them by Myntra.

arxiv-2201-13227.title: A Proof Procedure For Separation Logic With Inductive Definitions and Theory Reasoning
arxiv-2201-13227.creator: Mnacho Echenim, Nicolas Peltier
arxiv-2201-13227.description: Abstract A proof procedure, in the spirit of the sequent calculus, is proposed to check the validity of entailments between Separation Logic formulas combining inductively defined predicates denoting structures of bounded tree width and theory reasoning. The calculus is sound and complete, in the sense that a sequent is valid iff it admits a (possibly infinite) proof tree.

arxiv-2407-08609.title: BiasPruner : Debiased Continual Learning for Medical Image Classification
arxiv-2407-08609.creator: Nourhan Bayasi, Jamil Fayyad, Alceu Bissoto, Ghassan Hamarneh, Rafeef Garbi
arxiv-2407-08609.description: Abstract Continual Learning (CL) is crucial for enabling networks to dynamically adapt as they learn new tasks sequentially, accommodating new data and classes without catastrophic forgetting. Diverging from conventional perspectives on CL, our paper introduces a new perspective wherein forgetting could actually benefit the sequential learning paradigm.

arxiv-2411-19871.title: Thompson, Ulam, or Gauss? Multi-criteria recommendations for posterior probability computation methods in Bayesian response-adaptive trials
arxiv-2411-19871.creator: Daniel Kaddaj, Stef Baas, Edwin Y.N. Tang, David S. Robertson, Lukas Pin, and Sofía S. Villar
arxiv-2411-19871.description: Abstract Bayesian adaptive designs enable flexible clinical trials by adapting features based on accumulating data. Among these, Bayesian Response-Adaptive Randomization (BRAR) skews patient allocation towards more promising treatments based on interim data. Implementing BRAR requires the relatively quick evaluation of posterior probabilities.

arxiv-2509-08992.title: Cross-Service Token: Finding Attacks in 5G Core Networks Thanks: * Equal contribution.
arxiv-2509-08992.creator: Anqi Chen *, Riccardo Preatoni *, Alessandro Brighente, Mauro Conti, Cristina Nita-Rotaru
arxiv-2509-08992.description: Abstract 5G marks a major departure from previous cellular architectures, by transitioning from a monolithic design of the core network to a Service-Based Architecture (SBA) where services are modularized as Network Functions (NFs) which communicate with each other via standard-defined HTTP-based APIs called Service-Based Interfaces (SBIs).

arxiv-2512-14229.title: Complete Wetting and Drying at Sinusoidal Walls
arxiv-2512-14229.creator: Alexandr Malijevský, Martin Pospíšil, Miriam Magočiová, Jiří Janek
arxiv-2512-14229.description: Abstract We investigate complete wetting and drying at sinusoidally corrugated solid walls, focusing on the effects of wall geometry and interaction range. Two distinct interaction models are considered: one incorporating only short-ranged (SR) forces (applied to drying), and another including long-ranged (LR) van der Waals interactions (applied to wetting).

arxiv-2601-19571.title: Iwasawa theory for abelian towers of digraphs
arxiv-2601-19571.creator: Antonio Lei, Katharina Müller
arxiv-2601-19571.description: Abstract . Let p p and ℓ \ell be prime numbers, and d ≥ 1 d\geq 1 an integer. We formulate and prove Iwasawa main conjectures of the Picard groups and Bowen–Franks groups in ℤ p d \mathbb{Z}_{p}^{d} -towers of digraphs.

arxiv-2602-05506.title: Relying on LLMs: Student Practices and Instructor Norms are Changing in Computer Science Education DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: Make sure to enter the correct conference title from your rights confirmation email; June 03–05, 2018; Woodstock, NY ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06 CCS: Human-centered c
arxiv-2602-05506.creator: Xinrui Lin, Heyan Huang, Shumin Shi, John Vines
arxiv-2602-05506.description: Abstract . Prior research has raised concerns about students’ over-reliance on large language models (LLMs) in higher education. This paper examines how Computer Science students and instructors engage with LLMs across five scenarios: "Writing", "Quiz", "Programming", "Project-based learning", and "Information retrieval". Through user studies with 16 students and 6 instructors, we identify 7 key intents, including increasingly complex student practices.

pmc-10725178.creator: Ricardo Martín-Moya, Lorena Rodríguez-García, Beatriz Moreno-Vecino, Filipe Manuel Clemente, Antonio Liñán González, Francisco Tomás González-Fernández
pmc-10725178.description: BackgroundSoccer is the world’s most popular sport for both men and women. Tests of athletic and functional performance are commonly used to assess physical ability and set performance goals. The Functional Movement Screen (FMS™) is a widely used seven-test battery developed by practitioners to provide interpretable measure of movement quality.

pmc-11516841.title: Quantifying the health burden of environmental stressors
pmc-11516841.creator: J A Haagsma
pmc-11516841.description: The Burden of Disease (BoD) concept has gained increasing importance for health risk assessments, driven by the World Health Organization (WHO) and the Global Burden of Disease (GBD) studies. BoD utilizes the disability-adjusted life year (DALY) to express the population health impact of a disease, injury or risk factor.

pmc-11578311.title: Spatiotemporal Analysis of Mesenchymal Stem Cells Fate Determination by Inflammatory Niche Following Soft Tissue Injury at a Single‐Cell Level
pmc-11578311.creator: Chen Kan, Zhenya Tan, Haitao Wang, Wei Wang, Jiazhao Yang, Ya Zhang, Xiaoling Lu, Qirong Cheng, Lanyi Chai, Chao Peng, Jicheng Zhu, Chenghang Zhu, Hailin Wang, Li Zhan, Keqiong Lin, Yakun Liu, Lingqiang Zhang, Haitao Fan, Hong Zheng
pmc-11578311.description: Heterotopic ossification (HO), often arising in response to traumatic challenges, results from the aberrant osteochondral differentiation of mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs). Nevertheless, the impact of trauma‐induced inflammatory exposure on MSC fate determination remains ambiguous. In this study, the cellular diversity within inflammatory lesions is elucidated, comprising MSCs and several innate and adaptive immune cells.

pmc-11727195.title: Cerebrospinal Fluid Leak Prevention in Intradural Spine Surgery: A Long Series Analysis of Closure with Non-Penetrating Titanium Clips
pmc-11727195.creator: Leonardo Anselmi, Carla Daniela Anania, Maria Cleofe Ubezio, Generoso Farinaro, Donato Creatura, Alessandro Ortolina, Massimo Tomei, Ali Baram, Maurizio Fornari, Giovanni Grasso
pmc-11727195.description: Background/Objectives: Postoperative cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) fistulas remain a significant concern in spinal neurosurgery, particularly following dural closure. The incidence of dural tears during spinal surgery is estimated between 1.6% and 10%. While direct suturing remains the gold standard, it has a failure rate of 5–10%. Various materials and techniques have been used to enhance dural closure.

pmc-12965040.title: Deep‐Learning‐ versus Hypothesis‐Driven Modeling in Model‐Informed Drug Development: A PK/PD Case Study
pmc-12965040.creator: Roberto Gomeni, Françoise Bressolle‐Gomeni
pmc-12965040.description: Model‐informed drug development (MIDD) has traditionally been guided by hypothesis‐driven modeling, in which models are constructed based on established biological mechanisms, physicochemical principles, and experimental hypotheses. More recently, the rise of artificial intelligence has enabled data‐driven modeling approaches that often bypass explicit mechanistic assumptions. The potential synergy between these two paradigms is reshaping strategies for implementing MIDD.

pmc-13130076.title: Adult Bronchial Inflammatory Myofibroblastic Tumor: A Case Report
pmc-13130076.creator: Zhi-Hui Zheng, Bo Shao, Li-Kang Luo, Jia-Cheng Guan
pmc-13130076.description: Introduction:Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor (IMT) is a neoplasm originating from mesenchymal tissue and can occur in multiple parts of the body, such as the lungs, abdomen, pelvis, and retroperitoneum. Although the lung is a relatively common site for IMT, airway involvement in adults is rare, and most reported cases involve the central airway.

pmc-13251142.title: Outcomes of kidney transplants from donors after cardiac arrest; a UK population-based cohort study
pmc-13251142.creator: Ffion Dewi, Kamlesh Patel, James Hodson, Dimitra Limnatitou, Christine Biela, Angeliki Kosti, Adnan Sharif, Vasileios K Mavroeidis, Jay Nath
pmc-13251142.description: BackgroundKidneys from donation after cardiac arrest (DACA) donors are frequently offered for transplantation in the UK but concerns about organ quality may lead to potential reluctance to accept these kidneys. This study aimed to compare outcomes between DACA and other deceased donor (i.e. non-DACA) kidney recipients.

pmc-13563551.title: Primary care physician documentation in oncology electronic health records: prognostic marker or immortal-time bias?
pmc-13563551.creator: PE Heudel, J-Y Blay
pmc-13563551.description: BackgroundStructured administrative fields in oncology electronic health records (EHRs) are used in studies but their interpretation may depend on when they are completed. We assessed whether dated primary care physician (PCP) documentation was associated with survival after accounting for documentation timing.
